items.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010

ctx.x: And you correspond with the agent, and the agent may call you up and say look do you want to go to Ft. Lauderdale, they’re offering this — I mean do you get into that nitty gritty?

Yeah. I do that with my manager, and we do that with pretty much every show. You know everything is run by me and we figure everything out together, which is great. Especially now because I have a 2-year-old that travels with us, and it’ll be the kind of thing like well you know there might not be money for Jack’s plane ticket on this trip do you still want to take it, but if we connect it to this gig then it will work out and can your parents watch him during that time. You know, it’s like those kind of details.…
